articles.title: Toddlers learn by falling: Why DeFi's $20 billion TVL drop is just a market stress-test
articles.snippet: DeFi Technologies president Andrew Forson says the stablecoin layer is thriving, with more than $150 billion in U.S. Treasuries backing coins like USDT and USDC.

articles.title: Argentina bill targets crypto payments to illegal gambling sites
articles.snippet: Argentina’s proposed online gambling bill would restrict banks, payment firms and crypto providers from serving unauthorized betting platforms.

articles.title: Crypto card monthly transaction volume surges 230% from 2025
articles.snippet: Payment volume on crypto-linked credit and debit cards has been steadily increasing since 2024, reaching about $7.8 billion in cumulative transactions this month.

articles.title: What the Clarity Act Means for the Rest of the World
articles.snippet: The Senate’s crypto bill has supporters excited—and opponents concerned—about the bill’s potential reverberations beyond America’s borders.

articles.title: Bitcoin Slips Under $73K as Crypto Liquidations Near $1B
articles.snippet: The near-$1 billion crypto liquidation spree comes amid rising tensions over the U.S.-Iran conflict and ETF outflows.
